direction.concept: One evening told as a continuous horizontal passage: arriving with a mat, watching a short film, then turning to the director for conversation.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Across one shared creek-bank stage, an arriving adult unrolls a mat at left, seated adults face a film screen in the middle, and a small standing-and-seated group exchanges a microphone at right. A continuous ground line and river-edge railing connect the actions.
direction.expression_system: An expressive drawn frieze with angular body gestures, selective solid fills and a few decisive lines. The three actions are parts of one event scene, without separate poster frames, numbered chapters or invented programme times.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: First gaze: the strong title at upper-left and the flowing sequence beneath it. Next useful information: the schedule/venue group at upper-right. Practical instructions sit beside the arrival action; the screening/conversation descriptor sits beside the final action.
direction.whole_visual_layout: Use the full landscape width for a connected middle frieze at roughly y31–69%. The first two action zones overlap through the same ground and the last opens upward into conversation. Identity occupies upper-left x4-49% with a one-line Korean title and English beneath; schedule upper-right; two lower corner blocks relate to the actions above them, leaving the middle ground unobstructed.
direction.typography_plan: Korean title 40–42 px at width720, on one complete line within x4-49%, with English 18–20 px underneath. Date/time 23–28 px. All remaining entries at least 17 px. A vigorous, firm Korean sans has straight readable baselines; image gesture supplies movement.
direction.color_material_emotion: Warm light ground and decisive vermilion/charcoal shapes feel like a lively adult community arts invitation. Drawing stays visibly constructed and consistent, with crisp readable type and no simulated printing debris.
direction.distinction: Without color or medium terms, M3 unfolds several connected actions across a middle band with paired corner information blocks. M1 depicts one distant spatial instant and consolidates every text group in one right opening.

reference_observations.observed_principle: In the viewed cache, repeated figures vary in pose and silhouette, while nearby bilingual labels and consistent spacing make a dense population navigable.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Use varied adult actions to articulate the supplied event's arrival, screening and conversation. Replace the roster grid with one lateral action sequence and pair only the existing instructions with the relevant action.

reference_observations.observed_principle: The first personally viewed cache interlocks tilted colored planes, a long segmented form, glove-like gestures and varied letter sizes. Overlap, directional force and local information pockets form one composition.
reference_observations.current_request_application: Give the frieze a continuous directional rhythm and allow actions to overlap through a shared ground. Keep all supplied words in clean flat pockets rather than copying its comic characters, polygon arrangement or fragmented lettering.

direction.positive_construction: Join the three actions through one ground and railing, enlarge the two identities enough to balance the frieze, and place the existing instruction groups beside the actions they explain.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.
Outdoor short-film screening and conversation must be recognizable, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.
